self_intro: I'm Iván Palomares, PhD in Artificial Intelligence. I help businesses, profesionals, and organizations in leveraging Machine Learning, AI, and Data through high-impact training and educational initiatives, knowledge dissemination, and tech content creation such as tech writing.
solutions_intro: With over 15 years of tech experience, I work at the intersection between in-depth technology and business value. These are my specialization areas:
service1_text: I design and deliver custom programs on AI & Data Analysis with Python, Machine Learning, LLMs, automation (n8n), and end-user AI tools, to train technical and business teams, in-person or online.
service2_text: Expert writing of articles and technical documentation on AI. Author on world-renowned platforms such as Machine Learning Mastery and KDnuggets.
service3_text: Strategic advice to understand, adopt, and integrate AI-based solutions and workflow automation that solve real business problems.
exp1_text: Lead author of advanced tech content (AI, Data Science, NLP, LLMs) for global audiences in Machine Learning Mastery, KDnuggets, and DataCamp.
exp2_text: Design and delivery of B2B training for executive, tech, and interdisciplinary teams. Curriculum design and directorship experience in academic programs for institutions like EU Business School, EAE, universities, and multinational companies.
exp3_text: Experience leading Gen-AI and MLOps strategies, as well as designing AI adoption roadmaps in SaaS enterprises and international consultancy firms.
about_title: La IA no es magia, es ingeniería.
about_text: Soy Doctor (PhD) en Inteligencia Artificial. Durante la actual euforia generativa, aporto el rigor de mi perfil académico (ex-profesor universitario e investigador internacional) combinado con mi experiencia en consultoría corporativa. Trabajo con fluidez en español e inglés, convencido de que el éxito de cualquier modelo predictivo o sistema generativo reside en una base absoluta: la calidad de los datos.
